cards.card_text: David says they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
cards.verse_text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.

cards.card_text: David says the people around him speak with flattering lips and a double heart, and they ___ to one another.
cards.verse_text: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
